newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian soldier kills self in Bosnia - ministry.
newsitem.headline: Austrian soldier kills self in Bosnia - ministry.

text.p: An Austrian soldier on peacekeeping duty in Bosnia died late on Sunday from gunshot wounds after apparently committing suicide with his own weapon, the Austrian Defence Ministry said on Monday.

It said the 23-year-old soldier, whose name was given only as Michael G., had been on duty in Bosnia since February as part of the NATO-led IFOR mission in the town of Visoko, 25 km (16 miles) north-west of Sarajevo.
An investigation team had been dispatched to Bosnia, the ministry added in a statement.
Austria has contributed a total of 225 soldiers to the Bosnia peacekeeping effort.
